notes.title: Wood Guy Joins Indie Assemble – 50% Off Now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]🎉 Our First Global Steam Festival Appearance! 🎮[/b][/h1]

Big Milestone, Big Sale!

We’re thrilled to announce that Wood Guy has been [b]officially selected[/b] to take part in the Indie Assemble Steam Sale, a global celebration of indie games organized by Excaliber!

From May 5 to May 11, 2025, you’ll find Wood Guy featured among hundreds of amazing indie titles from studios around the world—and it’s [b]50% off[/b] for the occasion!

This marks [b]our very first participation in a third-party Steam sale event[/b], and we’re genuinely excited (and proud) to stand alongside so many creative, original, and passionate games. A huge thank you to the Indie Assemble team for the opportunity!

👉 Check out the full event page here:
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/IndieAssemble


As we continue our journey with Wood Guy, we’re also putting the finishing touches on our community Discord—we’re nearly there and can’t wait to share more very soon.

Thanks for being part of this adventure. Whether you're discovering Wood Guy for the first time or returning for more puppet-powered platforming, now’s a great time to jump in!

[b]👉 Grab Wood Guy at 50% off during Indie Assemble![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642860/Wood_Guy/

With gratitude,
YSO Corp

notes.title: Wood Guy - 1 Year Anniversary + 50% on Autumn Steam Sale 2024 !
notes.content:
[h1][b]A special “Thank You” ![/b][/h1]

A [b]year ago[/b], we proudly introduced Wood Guy to the Steam community—a handcrafted platformer filled with charm, physics, and fun. Our journey began with excitement, nerves, and a simple dream: to create a game that players would love as much as we loved making it.

Over the past year, we’ve tried to push our very first game on Steam, and it’s been a tougher journey than we expected. Now, as we celebrate Wood Guy’s first anniversary, we’ve made significant improvements to the Steam Page and are committed to building a stronger connection with our growing community. We’re [b]currently working on a dedicated Discord for our casual games[/b] and will share a special announcement when it’s ready! Looking forward, we’ll continue to refine and improve the game to ensure it provides a welcoming and immersive experience for all adventurers.

To celebrate Wood Guy’s first anniversary, we’re offering the game at [b]50% off[/b] during the Steam Autumn Sale 2024! 🍂 Whether you’re a seasoned adventurer or a new player looking to join the fun, now is the perfect time to dive into the handcrafted world of Wood Guy.

And that's not all! You can now watch the [b]official Wood Guy trailer[/b] on the YSO Corp - Media YouTube page. Experience the charm, gameplay, and adventure that make Wood Guy so special—check it out here: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ODuBYtulx6c

Thank you for making this year unforgettable. Here’s to many more years of adventure, crafting, and conquering challenges together. 🌲🪵

[b]👉 Get Wood Guy now at 50% off and join the celebration![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642860/Wood_Guy/

With gratitude,
The YSO Corp Team
